title: Gate-Tax Collectors
text: Uniformed gate collectors demand your route writ, your scar tally, and one impossible fee.

defeatReward.text: You forced the collectors to stamp a false transit chit.

woundOnLoss.prompt: The Collectors demand 1 Salvage after your defeat.

paidEffect.summary: The levy was paid. The Collectors remain unresolved.

unavailableEffect.summary: The levy could not be paid. No debt was created. The Collectors remain unresolved.
